title: Tight-constraint MgF2/Al2O3 defect cavity refinement with bounded thickness initialization
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining thickness initialization to neighborhoods around Candidate 0's verified geometry (mirror layers 35-55 nm, defect cavity 80-100 nm) will enable the optimizer to refine phase-matching within a proven topology rather than rediscovering basic periodicity, leading to improved target scores while maintaining physical validity.
design_principle: 1-D photonic crystal with periodic Bragg mirrors sandwiching a central defect cavity layer, using Transfer Matrix Method optimization with experimental optical constants. Mirror layers oscillate between low-index MgF2 and high-index Al2O3 at quarter-wave optical thickness for the UV passband center.
proposed_topology: Air | (MgF2/Al2O3) x4 | MgF2 | defect_Al2O3 | MgF2 | (Al2O3/MgF2) x4 | fused_silica. Total 17 finite layers: 8 mirror pairs plus 1 central defect layer.
theory_basis: Transfer Matrix Method for planar multilayer interference
Defect mode in 1-D photonic crystal creates narrow transmission peak within stopband
Quarter-wave stack principle for Bragg mirrors
expected_advantages: Reduced search dimensionality through bounded initialization
Faster convergence to local optimum near proven geometry
Maintains physical validity from prior iteration
known_risks: May converge to local optimum inferior to global solution
Limited exploration of alternative thickness regimes
MgF2/Al2O3 index contrast may be insufficient for wide stopband
execution_request_english: Optimize a 17-layer defect-cavity thin-film stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: MgF2, Al2O3, MgF2, Al2O3, MgF2, Al2O3, MgF2, Al2O3, MgF2, Al2O3 (defect cavity), MgF2, Al2O3, MgF2, Al2O3, MgF2, Al2O3, MgF2. Initialize layer thicknesses with mirror layers (all except layer 10) bounded to 35-55 nm range and defect cavity layer (layer 10) bounded to 80-100 nm range. Optimize all 17 thicknesses using differential evolution to maximize transmittance in 255-280 nm band while minimizing transmittance in 300-700 nm and 700-1100 nm bands. Total layer count fixed at 17. No metal layers. Use conventional dielectric optical constants for MgF2 and Al2O3. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 255-280 nm, 300-700 nm, 700-1100 nm. soft objectives: high transmittance in 255–280 nm; low transmittance in 300–700 nm; low transmittance in 700–1100 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 300–700 nm; transmittance in 700–1100 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layers ≤ 30; no metal layers; conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials only.
revision_reason: Refinement of route_01 based on feedback directives: constrain thickness initialization to neighborhoods around Candidate 0's verified geometry (mirror layers 35-55 nm, defect cavity 80-100 nm) to reduce search dimensionality and force optimizer to refine phase-matching rather than rediscovering basic periodicity.
